bandwidth_semantics.actual_received: NPU-link delivered GB/s from exact cumulative counter differences
bandwidth_semantics.interval_average_attributed_ssd_service: NPU-by-SSU v3 stable completed-command-plus-immutable-active-prefix counter difference divided by the 500-ms interval; not an instantaneous in-flight command rate; fragmented settle accumulation is excluded
bandwidth_semantics.ssd_outstanding: direct physical pending/active enumeration; never derived by cumulative-counter subtraction
bandwidth_semantics.instantaneous_inflight_ssd_command_rate: available only in active_command/probe physical_service_gbps fields; normally 40 GB/s for the one active non-preemptive command
bandwidth_semantics.controller_demand: remaining manifest IO / remaining controller compute
bandwidth_semantics.physical_demand: undelivered physical IO / same compute denominator; diagnostic only

adaptive_required_ratio_interpretation: alpha=2 feasibility configuration, not a live deadline check
adaptive_tuning_scope: alpha=2 tuned; alpha=1.5 is a same-trajectory sensitivity metric, not a separately alpha=1.5-tuned run
adaptive_prefetch_slack_policy: prefetch-only or not-yet-admitted requests have NA elapsed/slack and never enter slack plots

whole_64s.request_cohort_semantics: requests admitted in [relative_start_s,relative_end_s); TTFT completion may occur after relative_end_s
